sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Prof Peter Hindmarsh, an expert witness in the Lucy Letby trial, was excluded from clinical practice by his employer, University College London hospitals trust, in March 2023. The trust cited safety concerns regarding his advice on insulin. Despite this, Hindmarsh later provided a crucial expert report for a prosecution against Damion and Tamara Thomas. The jury in the Letby trial was not informed of his exclusion, and the Crown Prosecution Service only learned of the General Medical Council investigation into Hindmarsh in November 2025.

sections.text: The case raises significant questions regarding the use of expert witnesses in court. Legal rules require experts to disclose information that could undermine their credibility or impartiality. Hindmarsh’s failure to disclose his regulatory issues until long after writing his report has led to concerns about whether he complied with these disclosure obligations and whether his evidence was appropriately scrutinised.
